reviews.title: Works very well
reviews.comment: Great motherboard.  I updated the system BIOS before even before installing the board.  BIOS update went with no issues.  Installed the board and all other hardware.  Installed Windows 11.  System is fast and very responsive.
reviews.author: Technocrat

reviews.title: Perfect motherboard for a first time PC build
reviews.comment: Gigabyte did a great job with this motherboard. First ever PC build, matched this clean mobo with a 5600x cpu and 5600xt gpu. Easy build frame, nice cable organization options. Super nice option now with over priced DDR5 ram costs, DDR4 makes for a nice and capable budget friendly build. If it's your first build and you don't seek 4K gaming on ultra settings, this could be your base for a long term gaming station.
reviews.author: Pete

reviews.title: Worked out of the box with a 5800X3D
reviews.comment:
Supported 5800X3D out of the box.
Writing this to assist anyone else that has the same issue as I did.
This board is paired with an RTX 5070 and replaced a failing Asrock Steelseries micro b450. After replacing, I would receive a blank screen, the case fans would ramp to 100 percent and require a manual shutdown.
I was able to address the issue by using separate PCI-E 8pin rails from my PSU. I would also recommend reinstalling Windows.
No issues with my 5800XD3 and with the available features and a quick Google, I was able to under volt with better performance and knock about 7C off the average CPU temp.
reviews.author: Clint

reviews.title: Great board, great price
reviews.comment:
Excellent board. My only (very minor) complaint is that the ram slots are a little too close to the CPU socket so the fan on my CPU cooler had to be adjusted to sit a little higher than I would've liked. But, that's really more on me for not checking measurements before buying the cooler. Won't even be an issue if you're using an AIO or stock cooler.
Will need a BIOS update for 5000 series CPUs, so make sure you download an updated BIOS version to a flash drive prior to starting your build. The board supports Q flash, so you can even update without having to boot to the BIOS.
The board has an orange light along the back of the IO. It looks cool, but if you're anti-RGB like me you'll be happy to know that you can turn that off in the BIOS.
Overall really good board. If you're wondering if this is the one, it is.
reviews.author: Shane

reviews.title: Great AM4 board
reviews.comment: Hard to troubleshoot as there is no debug LED's on the board, other than that I just got it up and running with a 5900xt with no problems, plenty of USB headers with a high speed USB-c connector on the board for a front panel if you want it, just watch the install package that pops up on first boot, it tries to install Norton, you dont want that
